workflows.source:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  core-portability:
    name: Core (${{ matrix.os }}, Node 22)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm pack --dry-run
      - run: npm run pack:check
      - run: npm run pack:smoke

  node-compatibility:
    name: Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [20, 24]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test

  native-adapters:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'
      - uses: actions/setup-java@cf277c60eb25467037889841efdb72551f06f6c3 # v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.85.0 --profile minimal
          rustup default 1.85.0
          rustc --version
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Install native adapter test tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install pytest==8.4.2 pytest-json-report==1.5.0
          mkdir -p .test-tools
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/junit/platform/junit-platform-console-standalone/1.11.4/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar \
            --output .test-tools/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar
          echo "b016ef6b1c3454d6d7c2c88ce081dabf289699686af6622d6e4e2e1b54b4a2fc  .test-tools/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar" \
            | sha256sum --check
      - name: Execute all built-in adapter contracts
        run: npm run test:adapters
        env:
          MUSUBIX_RUN_NATIVE_ADAPTERS: '1'
          PYTEST_PYTHON: python
          JUNIT_CONSOLE_JAR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.test-tools/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar

  formal-solvers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Z3
        run: |
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3/releases/download/z3-5.1.0/z3-5.1.0-x64-glibc-2.39.zip \
            --output /tmp/z3.zip
          echo "f47be8d27d3230e823bf1eeede2fe0abaca55bb78d0b59974370e6689a92284a  /tmp/z3.zip" \
            | sha256sum --check
          unzip -q /tmp/z3.zip -d /tmp/z3
          echo "/tmp/z3/z3-5.1.0-x64-glibc-2.39/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Install pinned Lean toolchain
        run: |
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.33.1/lean-4.33.1-linux.tar.zst \
            --output /tmp/lean.tar.zst
          echo "890afd185370f85666025b883914ab4f4b339136f8c96167b69cfb62aecaf235  /tmp/lean.tar.zst" \
            | sha256sum --check
          tar --zstd -xf /tmp/lean.tar.zst -C /tmp
          echo "/tmp/lean-4.33.1-linux/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Run native formal solver integration tests
        run: npm test -- --run tests/p3-formal.test.ts
        env:
          MUSUBIX_RUN_Z3: '1'
          MUSUBIX_RUN_LEAN: '1'
      - name: Generate formal artifacts
        run: node dist/packages/cli/src/main.js formal generate assets/requirements.md --format both --json
      - name: Check with Z3
        run: node dist/packages/cli/src/main.js formal check assets/requirements.md --solver z3 --json
      - name: Check with Lean
        run: node dist/packages/cli/src/main.js formal check assets/requirements.md --solver lean --json

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Existing v* tag to release
        required: true
        type: string
      publish_npm:
        description: Request the separately approved npm publish job
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.release_tag || github.ref_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Verify manual release ref
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          test "$REF_TYPE" = "tag"
          test "$REF_NAME" = "$RELEASE_TAG"
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'
      - uses: actions/setup-java@cf277c60eb25467037889841efdb72551f06f6c3 # v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.85.0 --profile minimal
          rustup default 1.85.0
          rustc --version
      - name: Install Z3
        run: |
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3/releases/download/z3-5.1.0/z3-5.1.0-x64-glibc-2.39.zip \
            --output /tmp/z3.zip
          echo "f47be8d27d3230e823bf1eeede2fe0abaca55bb78d0b59974370e6689a92284a  /tmp/z3.zip" \
            | sha256sum --check
          unzip -q /tmp/z3.zip -d /tmp/z3
          echo "/tmp/z3/z3-5.1.0-x64-glibc-2.39/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Install pinned Lean toolchain
        run: |
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.33.1/lean-4.33.1-linux.tar.zst \
            --output /tmp/lean.tar.zst
          echo "890afd185370f85666025b883914ab4f4b339136f8c96167b69cfb62aecaf235  /tmp/lean.tar.zst" \
            | sha256sum --check
          tar --zstd -xf /tmp/lean.tar.zst -C /tmp
          echo "/tmp/lean-4.33.1-linux/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      - name: Install native adapter test tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install pytest==8.4.2 pytest-json-report==1.5.0
          mkdir -p .test-tools
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
            https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/junit/platform/junit-platform-console-standalone/1.11.4/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar \
            --output .test-tools/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar
          echo "b016ef6b1c3454d6d7c2c88ce081dabf289699686af6622d6e4e2e1b54b4a2fc  .test-tools/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar" \
            | sha256sum --check
      - name: Run native adapter integrations
        run: npm run test:adapters
        env:
          MUSUBIX_RUN_NATIVE_ADAPTERS: '1'
          PYTEST_PYTHON: python
          JUNIT_CONSOLE_JAR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.test-tools/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.11.4.jar
      - name: Run native formal solver integrations
        run: npm test -- --run tests/p3-formal.test.ts
        env:
          MUSUBIX_RUN_Z3: '1'
          MUSUBIX_RUN_LEAN: '1'
      - run: node dist/packages/cli/src/main.js formal check assets/requirements.md --solver z3 --json
      - run: node dist/packages/cli/src/main.js formal check assets/requirements.md --solver lean --json
      - run: npm run pack:check
      - run: npm run pack:smoke
      - name: Prepare package, SBOM, and checksums
        run: npm run release:prepare -- --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --output release-assets
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release-assets
          path: release-assets/
          if-no-files-found: error

  attest:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: release-assets
          path: release-assets
      - name: Create and verify strict GitHub OIDC attestation
        run: npm run release:attest -- release-assets
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release-attestation
          path: release-assets/musubix3-attestation.json
          if-no-files-found: error

  github-release:
    needs: [validate, attest]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.release_tag || github.ref_name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: release-assets
          path: release-assets
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: release-attestation
          path: release-assets
      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        run: |
          if gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets/* --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets/* --verify-tag --generate-notes
          fi

  npm-publish:
    needs: [validate, attest]
    if: inputs.publish_npm == true || vars.NPM_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: npm-publish
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - name: Install npm with Trusted Publishing support
        run: npm install --global npm@11.6.0
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: release-assets
          path: release-assets
      - name: Publish npm package with provenance
        run: npm run release:publish -- release-assets
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

name: Publish npm Release

run-name: Publish ${{ inputs.release_tag }} to npm

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Existing stable GitHub Release tag
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: npm-publish-${{ inputs.release_tag }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: npm-publish
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - name: Install npm with provenance support
        run: npm install --global npm@11.6.0
      - name: Verify npm authentication
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm whoami
      - name: Download and verify immutable release assets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: |
          [[ "$RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]
          mkdir release-assets
          gh release download "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --dir release-assets
          (cd release-assets && sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS)
          version="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
          tarball="release-assets/musubix3-${version}.tgz"
          test -f "$tarball"
          package_version="$(
            tar -xOf "$tarball" package/package.json |
              node -e "let text=''; process.stdin.on('data', chunk => text += chunk).on('end', () => process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(text).version))"
          )"
          test "$package_version" = "$version"
      - name: Publish exact release tarball
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: npm publish "./release-assets/musubix3-${RELEASE_TAG#v}.tgz" --provenance --access public
